purpose: Independent acceptance expectations for representative original-era fabric and declared normal-use operation. Not a verified individual building or regulatory certification.

policy.nominal_comparison_convention: Compare matching physical envelope roles and nominal forward U-values with declared surface films. Effective ground U-values require project geometry, soil and reference boundary conventions; declared project/reference limitations are nonblocking reviews, never benchmark passes. Missing or contradictory physical definitions remain blocking.
policy.density_comparison_convention: Compare only compatible material families and explicit kg/m3 bases; abs(thermal density - source density) / source density. Never modify a thermal property to satisfy a carbon mapping.

severity_policy.error: Contradictory or invalid supplied data, failed acceptance reference, or worsening intervention.
severity_policy.missing: Required catalogue definitions, material data or acceptance inputs absent; unknown is never a numerical zero or a pass. Declared project ground conditions and reference-convention limitations are reviews when physical fabric resolves.
severity_policy.review: Context or construction judgement required; not a certification or automatic rejection.

ground_assessment.scope: All authored archetypes and states; generic selections reuse their MF donor findings.
ground_assessment.reference_mapping_limitation: Unmapped TABULA Wall2 is a reference review, not an inferred basement role. Unverified prescribed renovation interventions remain missing.
ground_assessment.source_incompatibility: Known source boundary conflicts are retained as nonblocking reviews when the physical definition and mapping resolve.

sources.project_policy: User-approved Catalogue sanity-check rules; tolerances are project screening policies, not Swedish regulatory limits.
